pool.text: An ancient Sanskrit-Nepal Bhasa dictionary from the year was found in the area.
The Maru Satta public pavilion was rebuilt by Biseth during King Lakshmi Narasimha Malla's reign.
Portuguese Jesuit Father Joao Cabral passed through the valley and met the local king.
King Pratap Malla built a structure for his queen after the loss of their son.
The Gorkha Kingdom ended the Malla confederation following the Battle of Kathmandu.
Rana rule over Nepal began with the Kot massacre near Hanuman Dhoka Durbar.
The Barun Yantra Karyalaya fire service opened its first station in Kathmandu.
Air transportation was established and the construction of Tribhuvan Highway was started.
Sajha Yatayat was established to provide regular bus services throughout Kathmandu and the valley.
Boudhanath officially became a designated UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Nepal Television was established and became the oldest and most-watched television channel in Nepal.
The city has hosted the headquarters of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation.
The Municipality of Kathmandu was officially upgraded to the status of a metropolitan city.
The Firefighters Volunteer Association of Nepal was established to raise public safety awareness.
The Nepalese royal massacre at Narayanhiti Palace claimed the lives of several royals.
Kathmandu became the center of the People's Movement forcing the king to restore parliament.
The Constituent Assembly meeting in Kathmandu voted to abolish the monarchy and declare a republic.
Nepal Republic Media joined a publishing alliance to publish an international edition from Kathmandu.
A magnitude 7.8 earthquake struck Nepal, causing massive destruction and fatalities.
Trishna Shakya was installed as the new Kumari of Kathmandu succeeding the previous one.
